title: One Contract Suite, Three Storage Backends
instructions: Implement `SqlUsageRepo` (sqlite3, upsert, commit on every `add`, `close()`) and `FileUsageRepo` (JSON, atomic replace) in `repos.py`. `budget.py` is provided. One contract suite runs against the in-memory fake and both adapters, so all three must behave identically for unknown tenants, running totals, isolation and cross-instance visibility.

evidence.label: Unknown tenant has usage 0 on every backend
add returns the running total on every backend
Tenants are isolated on every backend
A write is visible through a second instance over the same storage
BudgetService enforces its limit on every backend
SqlUsageRepo data survives close and reopen
FileUsageRepo treats a missing file as no usage and does not create it
FileUsageRepo writes valid JSON and leaves no temp file behind
